messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] Elevated fncall error rate (5xx) and structured-output queue growth on production. Affected models: redwood/llama-800M-v2. Spike started ~2934567800. Link: https://incidents.redwood/2934567890

Ash (oncall): Ack. Paging SRE and eng-runtime. Will convene a quick mitigation plan.

Jeff (sre): On pager. Can we soft-gate external tool invocations first? Recommend global soft cap 10 req/s + per-tenant 2 req/s to buy time. Also consider disabling structured JSON/tool-call payloads (fallback to plain text) for affected endpoints.

Lina (eng-runtime): I can push gates. Running admin CLI now:
```
rwctl set-invoke-cap --scope global --rate 10/s --reason "live mitigation: fncall spike"
rwctl set-invoke-cap --scope tenant --rate 2/s
rwctl toggle-json-prune --on --reason "reduce structured output during overload"
```
I'll roll to canary then prod.

Ash (oncall): Please also flip the free-tier toolcall throttle for bursty tenants: `billingctl adjust-plan --tier free --invoke-rate 0.5/s` — prevents noisy neighbors.

Maya (pm): Which customers will see degraded tool functionality? Need a list so support can message them. Prioritize Dedicated/enterprise.

Emma (cs): Quick list: acme-inc (high), beta-studios (high), gamma-labs (medium), test-sandbox (low). I'll draft a short note explaining temporary disablement of tool-calls and structured outputs.

Jeff (sre): Lina — any logs/metrics after the gate?

Lina (eng-runtime): Pushed changes to runtime canary -> prod. Logs show gate applied: `invoke-gate: applied global=10/s tenant-default=2/s`. `json-prune: enabled`.

Jeff (sre): Good. Observability: 5xx rate dropped from ~4.2% to 0.9% within 3m. Latency stable. Streaming backlog drained. Keep caps for 30m then reassess.

Ash (oncall): Handing primary oncall to Jeff for next 30m to monitor mitigation. I'll own customer comms coordination. Creating postmortem stub: /incidents/2934567890/postmortem-draft.

Emma (cs): Drafted customer blurb and sent to Maya for sign-off. Short note: "We're temporarily restricting automated tool invocations and structured JSON outputs to maintain service reliability. No model data deleted. We're monitoring and will restore full features ASAP."

Maya (pm): Approved. Send to acme-inc & beta-studios now; include workaround: add retry/backoff and fallback to plain text generation.

Jeff (sre): After 15m monitoring window: metrics stable. Recommend keep current caps and json-prune for another 15m. If steady, start gradual relax: increase global -> 20/s, tenant -> 4/s, then toggle `json-prune` off in canary.

Lina (eng-runtime): Commands executed and recorded in ops log. Snippet:
```
opslog append --incident 2934567890 "apply: global 10/s tenant 2/s json-prune on"
```

IncidentBot: Status update saved. Mitigation active. Next automated update in 15m or earlier on pager. :bell:
